Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 22-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Data Structures and Algorithms [ECE_4447]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                What are the properties to be satisfied for an algorithm. Discuss each with an example.               (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                       Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           Illustrate and explain space complexity using suitable code.                                          (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Suggest an algorithm to find the transpose of a Sparse Matrix.                                        (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
2)                Illustrate and explain the postfix expression evaluation in stacks.                                   (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                        Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Discuss the implementation of Queues using linked lists.                                              (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           With an example code, explain the deletion operation at the end for a Singly linked list.             (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Illustrate and explain the methods for constructing an expression tree.                               (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                           Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Mention tree traversal operations and explain Inorder traversal with suitable example.                (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Prove that the height of AVL tree with 'n' elements is O(logn)                                        (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4)                With an illustration, explain the adjacency matrix to represent graphs.                               (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                        Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  
  Page #1

B)                Suggest an algorithm for Binary search considering both Best case and Worst case complexities.         (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Discuss the steps of Quick sort algorithm.                                                             (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
5)                        Differentiate between Linear Search and Binary Search mentioning the significance of both.             (4)  
  
  
  A)                                                             Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)                Discuss the steps involved in merge sort.                                                              (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)                Eloberate the steps involved in Breadth First Search (BFS) Alorithm                                    (3)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
